title: Fragment of a list of names
support: A small fragment of off-white marble, broken on all sides. Rear face is unworked and uneven.

material._: Very fine-grained, homogeneous, white, calcitic marble, likely Docimian, Pentelic. Digital microscopy: heteroblastic to homeoblastic fabric. lunense does not make sense. Sr too low for Goktepe. no smell so unlikely Hymettan (identification based on pXRF, digital microscopy, XRD)

layout.p: Traces of five lines of Greek letters, with some vacats before initial letters on the left side.

handNote.lettering: Widely spaced, neatly cut, regular letters of broad module. Alpha has straight bar; eta is wide; Mu has vertical outer strokes and half-length inner strokes; omicron is small and above the line (6mm); phi has a slightly extended vertical (14mm); omega is full size, circular, and open with horizontal feet.

provenanceFound._: Found in secondary deposition in the cimitero dell'ex Vigna Cassia c.1978, now in storage in the Museo archeologico, magazzino B, cass. 6

museum.name: Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi
museum.description: An outstanding collection of archaeological material. The collection ranges from Siracusa and the surrounding territory (Megara Hyblaia, Akrai, Kasmenai etc) to encompass all of eastern Sicily, reaching as far as Gela and Agrigento. The ground floor covers prehistory through to the end of the Classical period. Upstairs includes Hellenistic and Roman Syracuse and a display of material from the catacombs. A gallery displaying material from Hellenistic eastern Sicily is in preparation.
